description: Illustrative ANCFZ revision-2 POC catalog fixture. Actual SQL seed is infra/bootstrap/seed-sara-purchase.sql; document requirements below are provisional sandbox examples, not official ANCFZ requirements.

intents.name: Start a Company
intents.description: Help a new business owner choose a company structure, business activity, visa allocation and workspace, and optionally prepare a verified enquiry or quotation. A sandbox purchase requires a verified quote, configured document receipt, separate explicit consent and independent payment verification.
examplePhrases: I want to start a company

requirements.label: What will the company do?
requirements.hint: Ask only if not already supplied.

requirements.label: How many shareholders?
requirements.hint: Useful for FZE vs FZC structure.

requirements.label: How many visas will be needed?
requirements.hint: Ask after customer needs a visa-inclusive package comparison or quote.

requirements.label: What workspace do you prefer?
requirements.hint: Flexi-desk/shared office/private office; confirm actual package inclusions.

requirements.label: Which email should receive the enquiry?
requirements.hint: Only collect as part of a specifically consented lead; OTP identity handled outside model.

documentRequirements.label: Shareholder identity documents (sandbox checklist)
documentRequirements.guidance: Single synthetic PDF containing proposed shareholder identity pages; do not upload real identity files to localhost HTTP.

documentRequirements.label: Company formation application (sandbox checklist)
documentRequirements.guidance: Synthetic application form; validate the official requirements separately before enabling for real customers.

intents.name: Visa Services
intents.description: Explain residence visa services and help the customer request a case-specific enquiry.
examplePhrases: what visa services do you offer

intents.name: License Renewal
intents.description: Explain the licence-renewal process and help raise a renewal request.

intents.name: Corporate Banking Assistance
intents.description: Explain partner-bank assistance. Approval is solely at the bank's discretion.
examplePhrases: help me open a bank account

note: Purchase is supported only for company_formation in this POC. The SQL bootstrap publishes a versioned revision 2 for new tickets; existing revision-1 tickets keep their previous catalog. Only Node can accept purchase confirmation/document uploads and authorize OTP/payment. This checklist has not been certified against official ANCFZ document requirements.
